chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to me from his father, from Ahmad ibn Abi 'Abdillah, from Abi Jahm, from Abi Khadijah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'What is the extent (or greatness) of the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?' He replied, 'It is the best of deeds.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual status of visiting the grave of Imam Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) elevates the visitation of Imam al-Husayn’s (a.s.) grave to the status of the preeminent deed, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *tawassul* and the enduring spiritual presence of the Imams. This narration underscores the theological significance of the Karbala event, where martyrdom is viewed not as a defeat but as the ultimate act of worship and divine proximity.
